meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为对话机器人装上长期记忆,支持本地或远程两种运行方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 助手记住跨会话的上下文却不知怎么搭记忆服务
copy.tagline_en: Give your chatbot long-term memory, run locally or remotely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to recall context across sessions but need help wiring up memory.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在 Grok Bot 上会跑一个本地 worker 和 CMEM Pro 观察器;你开始真实任务时它会给出 session_start_context,并把记忆索引实时注入到该 agent 的记忆日志文件里。不需要 Cursor、xAI key 或 Claude CLI。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上安装或配置 claude-mem 时触发;默认接管本地 worker + CMEM Pro 观察器的安装流程。

say.text: 在我的 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem
say.note: 走默认 CMEM Pro 路径

say.text: 用 host provider 安装,启用本地登录观察器
装一个远程 worker,连到 https://cmem.ai

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs a local worker plus CMEM Pro observer on Grok Bot: it supplies session_start_context when a real task starts and injects a live memory index into that agent's memory log file. No Cursor, xAI key, or Claude CLI needed.
howto.when_en: Use it when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot; by default it takes over the local worker + CMEM Pro observer install path.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on my Grok Bot
say_en.note: Uses the default CMEM Pro path.

say_en.text: Install with the host provider to enable the local login observer
Install a remote worker pointed at https://cmem.ai
